semantics.Y1: A transitions to B only when w=1: y[0] & w
semantics.Y3: B, C, E, F transition to D when w=0: (y[1] | y[2] | y[4] | y[5]) & ~w
semantics.timing: Combinational next-state logic; specification provides state y as an input and no clock port.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset or stored state is specified; no clock, reset, initialization, or latency is added.

numeric.widths: All scalar ports one bit; y six bits.
numeric.operations: One-bit Boolean bitwise logic, no arithmetic or signed interpretation.

verification.oracle: Independent transition-table lookup for all six original one-hot states and both w values; expected outputs are bits 1 and 3 of destination state.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs and allow 1 ns combinational settling before checking.
verification.coverage: All 12 legal state/input pairs in both forward and reverse order.
verification.failure: Case inequality triggers $fatal; bounded watchdog; PASS printed only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for zero-hot, multi-hot, or X/Z state/input values is not specified by the assumed one-hot state encoding; implement direct incoming-transition Boolean equations without additional invalid-state handling.
